Mary E. Munce.
Preserved Primary Document • munce-m4.htm
Mary Elizabeth Munce, called "Lizzie", was born in Kent Co., DE on
8 September 1841
.
She was the daughter of  Robert Munce  and his wife, Jemima Hansor.
Photo courtesy of Harry Muncey
Sometime around
1861
she married Nehemiah Morris Sammons and they had, at least, the following children:
Amanda Sammons (
1864
-  )
Esther Sammons (
1865
-  )
Mary Elizabeth Sammons (
1866
-  )
Isaac Sammons (Oct.
1867
-   ) married Rebecca A.
James Sammons (
1873
-  )
Arwell (?) Sammons (Sept.
1875
-  ) married Mary Elizabeth Clark on October 28,
1896
Perry T. Sammons (
1877
-  ) married Bertha Dean on January 11,
1907
Lillie M. Sammons (Oct.
1879
- ) married Harry Wright on February 10,
1904
William Garfield Sammons (May
1882
-  ) married Ella Durham
Mary Elizabeth died on 8 November,
1914
. Her husband, Nehemiah, died on
11 March 1924
. Both are buried at Immanual Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold, DE. Their grave marker says they were parents of 6 boys and 6 girls but I do not have their names.

Mary E. Munce.

Preserved Primary Document • munce-m4.htm

Mary Elizabeth Munce, called "Lizzie", was born in Kent Co., DE on 8 September 1841. She was the daughter of Robert Munce and his wife, Jemima Hansor. Photo courtesy of Harry Muncey Sometime around 1861 she married Nehemiah Morris Sammons and they had, at least, the following children: Amanda Sammons (1864- ) Esther Sammons (1865- ) Mary Elizabeth Sammons (1866- ) Isaac Sammons (Oct. 1867 - ) married Rebecca A. James Sammons (1873- ) Arwell (?) Sammons (Sept. 1875 - ) married Mary Elizabeth Clark on October 28, 1896 Perry T. Sammons (1877- ) married Bertha Dean on January 11, 1907 Lillie M. Sammons (Oct. 1879- ) married Harry Wright on February 10, 1904 William Garfield Sammons (May 1882- ) married Ella Durham Mary Elizabeth died on 8 November, 1914. Her husband, Nehemiah, died on 11 March 1924. Both are buried at Immanual Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold, DE. Their grave marker says they were parents of 6 boys and 6 girls but I do not have their names.
